paragraphs: See the entry R' Asi bar Nakan; he is a Tanna, as in Bava Batra 121a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כב״ב קכא.. is read as “as in Bava Batra 121a,” with period convention and terminal stop; no named edition is independently checked. The source’s “he is a Tanna” remains without independent historical identification.
Yosi and Asi remain distinct supplied forms. The heading was recorded as provisional, with an earlier audit נתן instead of supplied נקן, Nakan. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
